column41: Aug 1: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Saturday that Smith (neck) will need at least 3-to-4 weeks to ramp back up to full speed, including a rehab assignment, Katie Woo of The Athletic reports.
Aug 3: Frelick (shoulder) began a hitting progression early last week and started a throwing progression Friday, MLB.com reports.
